title: The Evidence Room
story: Someone left a messy folder called ~/archive/ with hundreds of files inside. Only one of them is the real evidence. Find it, put it where it belongs, and clean up the rest.
description:
1. Locate the .evd file inside ~/archive/ containing the exact phrase a3da2_sherket_nvidia_microntech and move it into ~/evidence/ (create the folder if needed).

2. Delete the ~/archive/decoy_trap directory completely.

3. Find the researcher handle with the highest numeric score in ~/archive/scores.txt and save that handle inside a new file in ~/evidence/.

4. Run quest check to claim your flag.
